seoTitle: Scottsdale Unified Calendar 2026–27: Key Dates & PDF
seoDescription: See Scottsdale Unified’s 2026–27 first and last days, breaks, early-release dates, conferences, dismissal times, and official calendar PDFs.
heroSummary: Scottsdale Unified students start the 2026–27 school year on Monday, August 10, 2026. The last day for students is Thursday, May 27, 2027. The calendar includes 180 student instructional days, Fall Break from October 12–16, Winter Break from December 21–January 1, and Spring Break from March 15–19. Early-release schedules vary by grade and school, so check your school’s bell schedule for the exact dismissal time.

sourceReviewSummary: Verified against SUSD’s district calendar page and the official 2026–27 English PDF. The calendar was approved by the SUSD Governing Board on June 9, 2026, and the district page lists a June 15, 2026 update.
sourceReviewDetails: We checked the first day, last day, recesses, no-school days, early-release labels, final exam window, board approval date, and student instructional-day total.
The PDF separates districtwide early releases, elementary and K–8 conference-day early releases, middle school conference-day early releases, and high school final exam early releases.
The second page of the PDF includes school directory bell schedules; families should verify exact dismissal times with their campus.
Source note: The district PDF uses conflicting K–8 school counts in its conference-day labels and calendar key. We have not independently resolved that discrepancy.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Scottsdale Unified start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Scottsdale Unified students start the 2026–27 school year on Monday, August 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all SUSD early-release days follow the same schedule?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The SUSD calendar says early release varies by grade and separately marks districtwide early releases, elementary/K–8 conference days, middle school conference days, and high school final exam early releases.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fall Break for Scottsdale Unified in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, October 12, through Friday, October 16, 2026. Students are also off Friday, October 9 for a staff professional development day.

calendarFaqs.q: Is the last day of school an early-release day?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. Thursday, May 27, 2027 is the last day of school and is marked as early release for all grades, including pre-K.

calendarFaqs.q: What time does SUSD dismiss students on early-release days?
calendarFaqs.a: The district PDF lists 1:15 p.m. for most elementary schools and 12:20 p.m. for most middle and high schools. A few campuses use different times, so check your school’s bell schedule before planning pickup.

customSections.label: How Scottsdale Unified’s Calendar Works
customSections.content: SUSD does not use one early-release schedule for every school. Some dates apply to all grades, while conference and final-exam schedules vary by school level. Use the district calendar for the date and your school’s bell schedule for the dismissal time.

rows: The calendar marks several dates as early release for all grades, including pre-K.

October and spring conference windows are split between elementary/K–8 schools and middle schools. The PDF’s conference-day labels and calendar key do not agree on the number of K–8 schools covered. Confirm the schedule with your school.
High school finals and early release
High school final exams are scheduled for December 16–18 and May 25–27. December early release applies to high schools, while the May dates are early-release days for all grades.
October 9 and January 4 are no-school days for students because staff have professional development or preparation time.
The SUSD PDF includes campus schedules and early-release times. Check your school’s bell schedule for the latest dismissal time.
A Spanish-language district calendar PDF is available for 2026–27.

customSections.label: SUSD Early-Release Times by School Type
customSections.content: The district PDF lists early-release times for each school. Elementary schools generally dismiss at 1:15 p.m., while most middle and high schools dismiss at 12:20 p.m. K–8 schools and a small number of campuses follow different schedules, so confirm the time with your school before arranging pickup or childcare.
